title: Transfer dynamics of photo-generated carriers in catalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,6553-6596
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00512D, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jun Wang, Wanru Liao, Yao Tan, Olivier Henrotte, Yicui Kang, Kang Liu, Junwei Fu, Zhang Lin, Liyuan Chai, Emiliano Cortes, Min Liu
Carrier transfer plays the crucial role that dominates the overall photo-assisted catalytic performance. Understanding carrier transfer dynamics through various advancing characterizations can offer insights for developing high-performance catalysts.
